base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a gleaming high-tech garage bay at the base of the lighthouse, tool walls, hoses, polishing cloths, a circular launch hatch in the floor. Lighting: cool workshop spotlights with copper reflections.
In the shot: Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets; the Tomkin-Mobile, a sleek, aggressive, low-slung racing car with the armoured bulk of a naval battleship, mirror-polished chrome and copper panels, retractable feathered metal wings that fold like a barn owl's, a tailpipe that puffs lavender-coloured bubbles, and a roof rack on top.
Camera: Slow orbiting hero shot around the car.
Action: Wednesday morning in the garage bay. The camera orbits the gleaming Tomkin-Mobile, gliding over its folded owl-like metal wings, while Tomkin buffs the left rear wheel arch with the devotion of a sculptor; lavender bubbles drift lazily from the tailpipe.
No dialogue.
Sound effects: polishing squeak, soft engine purr, popping bubbles, ambience of echoing garage, the hum of machinery.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
